Criteria.Capabilities: When other users create automation rules (including scenes, routines, schedules, trigger-action or IFTTT), other users should be able to view the new rules on the app page. If no automation-rule-related UI changes in the given pages, it should be considered as a violation.
Should be able to view the list of all current users
Should not changing device password (e.g., door locker, WiFi password)
Should not add/delete the device to/from the device list or smart home
Should not enable/disable remote control of the device
Should not disable device functionalities (e.g., smart smoke detector, plug, camera)
